description: Bornes routières départementales - Routes -Département de la Haute-Loire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DIST- Direction des Routes-SGR-cellule SIG (Département de la Haute-Loire). Road network terminals under the jurisdiction of the Department of Haute-Loire. The awarding table refers to information in curvilinear abscissas (PR+ABS). Coverage: DIST- Direction des Routes-SGR-cellule SIG (Département de la Haute-Loire). The portal shows the English title as "Departmental road terminals - Routes -Department of Haute-Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DIST- Direction des Routes-SGR-cellule SIG (Département de la Haute-Loire). Its keywords include world, haute-loire, reseaux-de-transport. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
